title: Control-M Agent Connectivity Loss
dataSources: Control-M Automation API job status (`controlm:job`), Control-M/EM gateway and agent logs (`controlm:em`, `controlm:agent`).
app: Control-M/EM logs and the Control-M Automation API (`/run/jobs/status`) via HEC scripted inputs; Control-M reporting database via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=controlm:em ("Agent" AND ("Unavailable" OR "Disconnected" OR "lost"))
| rex "Agent (?<agent>\S+)"
| stats count as events, latest(_time) as last_event by agent
| sort - last_event
description: Detects Control-M/EM messages reporting agents going unavailable or disconnected, which stop all jobs scheduled on the affected host.
value: An offline agent halts every job on that server; immediate detection prevents a cascade of downstream batch failures.
implementation: Ingest Control-M/EM gateway logs; schedule every 5 minutes and alert on any agent-unavailable event for a production host.
visualization: Table of agent by last event, status panel.
grandmaExplanation: We notice when a machine running scheduled jobs drops off the network so it can be reconnected before jobs pile up.
